tagline: MULTI-ENTITY FINANCE  ·  CAPITAL STRATEGY  ·  FP&A  ·  SYSTEMS MODERNIZATION
profile: Strategic finance executive with experience in multi-entity structures, capital strategy, and systems modernization. Leads FP&A, budgeting, forecasting, treasury, and cash management across multi-entity client organizations; directs audit readiness and internal controls; and has served as financial architect for a $200M national banking-development initiative covering capital planning and financial structuring. Built payroll, HR, and benefits infrastructure and implemented ERP systems that improved processing efficiency 60%. Advises CEOs and Boards on long-range planning and builds financial literacy across leadership teams.

bullets.text: Provide hands-on leadership in multi-entity finance, public funding, capital strategy, and audit remediation.
Lead financial planning, budgeting, treasury, liquidity management, and cash-flow forecasting for client organizations across nonprofit, private, education, and public-sector settings.
Spearhead liquidity and working-capital strategy, including covenant monitoring, short-term financing analysis, and stress testing; support capital allocation through scenario modeling.
Direct audit readiness and external audit processes; ensure GAAP and Uniform Guidance compliance; design internal controls and fund-accounting frameworks.
Execute financial turnarounds, forensic accounting, historical clean-up, and audit remediation for organizations with reporting deficiencies.
Identified and recovered $1.5M+ in tax savings through detailed financial analysis and correction of reporting deficiencies.
